integrity: Proved in finite two-Hermite subspace by an exact Gaussian cross-Wigner calculation, radial integral, and exhaustive one-variable quadratic optimization. Independent scientific validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only centered finite annuli with positive dimensionless inner radius.
Only normalized complex superpositions of the first two ordinary Hermite levels; no unrestricted Wigner optimizer is asserted.
The squared Wigner L2 functional is used; the Wigner signed integral is a different functional.
Unindexed equivalent historical calculations may exist.
title: Sharp two-level Wigner annulus concentration and its coherent transition
